ideas.pitch: A multilingual AI-powered voice assistant bridging the healthcare communication gap for rural patients in India.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world problem solving with meaningful AI & ML integration emphasizing localized health awareness.
ideas.title: ArogyaVani
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on the winning pattern of multilingual health chatbots and RAG-based voice assistants, heavily appealing to judges looking for grassroots social impact in India.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven clinical OSCE training simulator evaluating medical students on diagnostic interviews and clinical rubrics.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world problem solving for healthcare education and practical professional training.
ideas.title: MediSim AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors a proven grand-prize winning project model by combining LLM roleplay with interactive scoring rubrics for a high-value niche.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent campus workspace and lab reservation engine featuring real-time occupancy tracking and automated conflict resolution.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world operational inefficiency within institutional resource allocation.
ideas.title: SmartSpace AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adapts a proven runner-up architecture into a specialized tool for college campuses, matching the organizing student demographic.

ideas.pitch: A computer-vision-powered automated waste classification prototype utilizing edge inference to sort recyclables.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world environmental sustainability and waste management optimization.
ideas.title: EcoSort AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of physical build combined with computer vision, offering an engaging live demo that stands out among pure web apps.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous data lineage and incident response agent that detects schema breaks and opens verified pull requests automatically.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world engineering productivity and automated backend incident remediation.
ideas.title: DataGuard Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the exact technical architecture of a recent major hackathon grand prize winner, appealing to technical judges who appreciate deep agentic workflows.
